name: Queue field-service estimates for dispatcher follow-up after phone review

parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.dispatch_estimate_queue (
 estimate_id text PRIMARY KEY, revision integer NOT NULL CHECK (revision > 0),
 scope text NOT NULL, total_cents integer NOT NULL CHECK (total_cents > 0),
 status text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('Queued','Requesting','Awaiting reply','Ready to send','Needs changes','On hold')),
 question_id text, review_until timestamptz, next_check timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now());

WITH accepted AS (
 INSERT INTO public.dispatch_estimate_queue AS q (estimate_id,revision,scope,total_cents,status)
 VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,'Queued')
 ON CONFLICT (estimate_id) DO UPDATE SET revision=EXCLUDED.revision,scope=EXCLUDED.scope,total_cents=EXCLUDED.total_cents,status='Queued',question_id=NULL,review_until=NULL,next_check=now(),updated_at=now()
 WHERE q.revision < EXCLUDED.revision
 RETURNING status)
 SELECT $1::text AS estimate_id, $2::int AS revision,
 CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT FROM accepted) THEN 'queued'
 WHEN EXISTS (SELECT FROM public.dispatch_estimate_queue WHERE estimate_id=$1 AND revision=$2 AND scope=$3 AND total_cents=$4) THEN 'already received'
 ELSE 'not applied; read current revision before retrying' END AS receipt;

WITH candidate AS (
 SELECT estimate_id,status FROM public.dispatch_estimate_queue
 WHERE status IN ('Queued','Requesting','Awaiting reply') AND next_check <= now()
 ORDER BY next_check,estimate_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
 UPDATE public.dispatch_estimate_queue q SET
 status=CASE WHEN c.status='Queued' THEN 'Requesting' WHEN c.status='Requesting' OR q.review_until<=now() THEN 'On hold' ELSE q.status END,
 review_until=CASE WHEN c.status='Queued' THEN now()+interval '6 minutes' ELSE q.review_until END,
 next_check=now()+interval '1 minute', updated_at=now()
 FROM candidate c WHERE q.estimate_id=c.estimate_id
 RETURNING q.estimate_id,q.revision,q.scope,q.total_cents,q.question_id,q.status;

parameters.question: ={{ "Release estimate " + $json.estimate_id + " rev " + $json.revision + " for dispatcher follow-up? USD " + ($json.total_cents / 100).toFixed(2) + ". " + $json.scope }}

parameters.query:
UPDATE public.dispatch_estimate_queue SET question_id=$3,status='Awaiting reply',next_check=now(),updated_at=now()
 WHERE estimate_id=$1 AND revision=$2 AND status='Requesting' AND length($3)>0 RETURNING estimate_id,revision,status;

UPDATE public.dispatch_estimate_queue SET status=CASE
 WHEN review_until<=now() THEN 'On hold'
 WHEN $4='yes' THEN 'Ready to send' WHEN $4='no' THEN 'Needs changes'
 WHEN $4='pending' THEN 'Awaiting reply' ELSE 'On hold' END,updated_at=now()
 WHERE estimate_id=$1 AND revision=$2 AND question_id=$3 AND status='Awaiting reply'
 RETURNING estimate_id,revision,status;

parameters.content:
## Dispatcher estimate queue
For a field-service dispatcher who needs the owner to clear an estimate before sending it. Each estimate has one current row in PostgreSQL. Filter status = Ready to send to find approved drafts. Your dispatcher sends the quote. This workflow never contacts the customer.

## Setup
Use a dedicated PostgreSQL database. Tested setup: n8n 2.48.7, PostgreSQL 16 and n8n-nodes-pushary 0.3.1. Select a Postgres credential on every database node with permission to create the queue table, then insert, read and update rows. Run Initialize queue once. Install [n8n-nodes-pushary](https://n8n.io/integrations/pushary/) and select the same paired owner’s Pushary API credential on both phone nodes. Set Basic Auth on the webhook and publish.

## Intake
POST one JSON object to the production webhook from your quoting tool. Use HTTPS and the configured Basic Auth. Example: `{"estimate_id":"JOB-21","revision":1,"scope":"Replace kitchen tap","total_cents":24500}`. Reuse the same ID and revision on retries. Increase the revision when scope or price changes. An older revision cannot replace a newer one.

## Dispatcher checks
The worker handles one due row per minute. Yes marks the current revision Ready to send. No marks Needs changes. A pending reply stays open for six minutes. A later revision clears the previous decision. Inspect On hold rows and failed executions manually. If sending failed after a request may have reached the phone, reconcile it before submitting a new revision.

## Workflow map
![Dispatcher workflow from estimate intake to recorded owner answer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pushary/n8n-nodes-pushary/193301f12d647b32903999df8963413aa35898da/examples/dispatcher-queue.png)
